text:
Alex: Heads-up — noticed console quota graphs dropping for a subset of requests after the TS/Go SDK header change this morning. Seems attributed to missing policy mapping in console telemetry.
Maya: Oof, saw that too. Which header rename? route-intent -> x-rd-route? @Ravi
Ravi: We rolled the SDK change (compact-routeheader) at 09:12. SDK now sends x-rd-route-priority instead of route-affinity. Console ingestion expects route-affinity.
Jules: Runtime emits both for a short window; the batching proxy strips unrecognized headers. So downstream console gets null for route tag.
Alex: Repro steps: curl with old header -> shows metric; new header -> falls into default bucket. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/ops/clip123
Maya: Proposed fix: add a short mapping layer in console ingestion that maps new header to the old metric key, and emit a log line when mapping is used. Maybe behind a feature flag for 48h.
Ravi: +1 but we should also patch SDKs to send legacy header when a toggled env var present for canary. That avoids lost metrics during rollout.
Nora: UX/Dashboard question: If we map during ingestion, do alerts (quota burn/SL) stay accurate? We need to ensure per-tenant aliases are preserved.
Jules: Implementation note: ingestion runs in the metrics pipeline (k8s service metrics-ingest). Adding header mapping is cheap: simple remap in the header parser stage. But we must update sampling keys used by aggregators to include mapped tag.
Alex: Small code suggestion:
```
# pseudo-python in metrics-ingest
hdr = headers.get("x-rd-route-priority") or headers.get("route-affinity")
if hdr:
  tags["route_affinity"] = normalize(hdr)
```
Maya: Timeline: deploy mapping to staging in next 2 hours, enable FF for 10% tenants, validate dashboards for 2 hours, then ramp.
Ravi: Also add a telemetry event from SDKs when legacy header fallback is enabled: {event: "route_header_compat", sdk: "py", mode: "legacy_fallback"} so we can count.
CI-bot: deploy to staging started by @Maya — build 1382 — logs: https://ci.redwood/build/1382
Jules: Be careful — aggregator dedup window is 60s; mapping could create duplicate metrics if both headers present. Plan: dedupe by preferring the new header if both exist.
Nora: Add a note for Support: "If you see sudden drop in Route X usage, toggle compat env var on SDKs or enable ingestion mapping."
Maya: I'll open an infra PR and a support KB.
Alex: thanks all. Will monitor and drop a follow-up in #incidents if anything flares. :thumbsup:
CI-bot: deploy to staging complete — 1768000300
Maya: Staging validated, no regression. Rolling to prod FF 10% now.
Ravi: Prod FF deployed — 1768000450 — monitoring for metric parity now.
